title: Inmate, 54, dies at Stony Mountain Institution
subtitle: Michael McKay had been serving time at the prison since December 2020
article: An inmate at Stony Mountain Institution north of Winnipeg has died.
Michael McKay, 54, died Monday, the Correctional Service of Canada said in a news release on Wednesday.
McKay had been serving a sentence of six years, one month and 11 days since Dec. 10, 2020. The release did not say what he had been convicted of or how he died.
The CSC says it will review the circumstances and have notified police and coroner as per policy.
